What's new in Vekrun 0.5.5 — Datadog, and one debug report

• Datadog through the browser sign-in reads Error Tracking when its answer has a heading, a note or a code fence around the data, and an answer that says there are no issues is an empty list rather than an error. If an answer still can't be read, Vekrun keeps a redacted sample for the debug report, so the cause can be seen instead of guessed.
• One debug report: "Save diagnostic report" (Settings → Environment diagnostics) and "Export debug info" (Settings → Updates) save the same zip — versions, this Mac, toolchains, agents, settings, recent Work Items and any unreadable answers, with secrets removed — with Show in Finder. The report says the app's real version, and the page no longer jumps while it saves.
• Errors since: choosing a day only sets it; Sync now brings the errors in.
